items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: I was wondering that I'm doubting Thomas.

ctx.x: What about the swells? What were they like, the swells?

But I'm going to tell you all one thing. I've always asked the Almighty God. Because those fellows like Manetta and Phil and Boca and them, they used to tell me these things and I used to deny them. You see? In other words I was wondering that I'm doubting Thomas.
